title: A Echo for the Static
author: Ivo Brightwater
blurb: Ansel Marchetti, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
